effect_description_eng: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [Hybrid] or [Ten Warriors] trait and 1 Tamer card with an inherited effect among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] You may play 1 Tamer card with an inherited effect from your hand with the play cost reduced by 2.
